bias.zh: 看空 · 跌回 5 日均线下方，逼近 $133–134.5

read.en: SpaceX fell 3.8% on Nov 4 to $135.92, trading between $133.14 and $140.50 on heavier volume; there is no 200-day yet (101 sessions). It is below the falling 5-day ($138.4), 10-day ($142.5) and 30-day ($151.0) averages and the 100-day ($145.3). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 14 and below zero, histogram roughly flat; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 14 ($158.30), and RSI is 40.
read.zh: SpaceX 11月4日下跌 3.8%，收于 $135.92，盘中区间 $133.14–140.50，成交量放大；上市仅 101 个交易日，尚无 200 日均线。股价位于下行的 5 日（$138.4）、10 日（$142.5）和 30 日均线（$151.0）以及 100 日均线（$145.3）下方。MACD 自 10月14日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图大致持平；抛物线 SAR 自 10月14日起看空（$158.30），RSI 为 40。

read.en: The close gave back the 5-day and the $140.3–140.7 support, now resistance, and the $133.1 low dipped under the $134–134.5 support before the close held above it. Resistance is $138.4 (5-day), then $140.5–140.7 and $142.1–142.7 (10-day, Oct 28 low, Nov 3 high). Support is $133.1–134.5, then $130.2–130.4 and $125.3–126.7. A close above $140.7 would target $142–143; below $133, $130.

s.en: Nov 4 low $133.1; Aug 12 low $134.0; Oct 30 low $134.5
